7.odr_com: his sonnes, and nephewes, daughters, and al his progenie together.
7.sabates_a: His sons, and nephews, daughters, and all his progeny together.
7.madueke_b: His sons, and nephews, daughters, and all his progeny together.

8.s_dismas: And theſe are the names of the children of Iſrael, that entred into Ægypt, him ſelfe with his children. His firſt-begotten Ruben.
8.odr_com: And these are the names of the children of Israel, that entred into Ægypt, him selfe with his children. His first-begotten Ruben.
8.sabates_a: And these are the names of the children of Israel, that entered into Ægypt, himself with his children. His first-begotten Ruben.
8.madueke_b: And these are the names of the children of Israel, that entered into Aegypt, himself with his children. His first-begotten Ruben.

9.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Heſron and Charmi.
9.odr_com: The sonnes of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Hesron and Charmi.
9.sabates_a: The sons of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Hesron and Charmi.
9.madueke_b: The sons of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Hesron and Charmi.

10.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Simeon: Iamuel and Iamin and Ahod, and Iachin and Sohar, and Saul the ſonne of Chananiteſſe.
10.odr_com: The sonnes of Simeon: Iamuel and Iamin and Ahod, and Iachin and Sohar, and Saul the sonne of Chananitesse.
10.sabates_a: The sons of Simeon: Iamuel and Jamin and Ahod, and Jachin and Sohar, and Saul the Son of Chananitess.
10.madueke_b: The sons of Simeon: Iamuel and Jamin and Ahod, and Jachin and Sohar, and Saul the Son of Chananitess.

11.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Leui: Gerſon and Caath and Merari.
11.odr_com: The sonnes of Leui: Gerson and Caath and Merari.
11.sabates_a: The sons of Levi: Gerson and Caath and Merari.
11.madueke_b: The sons of Levi: Gerson and Caath and Merari.

12.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Iuda: Her and Onan & Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were ſonnes borne to Phares: Heſron and Hamul.
12.odr_com: The sonnes of Iuda: Her and Onan & Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were sonnes borne to Phares: Hesron and Hamul.
12.sabates_a: The sons of Juda: Her & Onan and Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were sons born to Phares: Hesron and Hamul.
12.madueke_b: The sons of Juda: Her & Onan and Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were sons born to Phares: Hesron and Hamul.

13.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Iſſachar: Thola and Phua and Iob and Semron.
13.odr_com: The sonnes of Issachar: Thola and Phua and Iob and Semron.
13.sabates_a: The sons of Issachar: Thola and Phua and Job and Semron.
13.madueke_b: The sons of Issachar: Thola and Phua and Job and Semron.

14.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Zabulon: Sared & Elon and Iahelel.
14.odr_com: The sonnes of Zabulon: Sared & Elon and Iahelel.
14.sabates_a: The sons of Zabulon: Sared and Elon and Iahelel.
14.madueke_b: The sons of Zabulon: Sared and Elon and Iahelel.

15.s_dismas: Theſe are the ſonnes of Lia, which ſhe bare a)in Meſopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. Al the ſoules of his ſonnes and daughters are thirtie three.
15.odr_com: These are the sonnes of Lia, which she bare in Mesopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. Al the soules of his sonnes and daughters, are thirtie three.
15.sabates_a: These are the sons of Lia, which she bare in Mesopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. All the souls of his sons and daughters are thirty three.
15.madueke_b: These are the sons of Lia, which she bare in Mesopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. All the souls of his sons and daughters are thirty three.

16.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni and Eſebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.
16.odr_com: The sonnes of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni and Esebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.
16.sabates_a: The sons of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni & Esebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.
16.madueke_b: The sons of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni & Esebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.

17.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Aſer: Iamne and Ieſua and Ieſſui and Beria, Sara alſo their ſiſter. The ſonnes of Beria: Heber and Melchiel.
17.odr_com: The sonnes of Aser: Iamne and Iesua and Iessui and Beria, Sara also their sister. The sonnes of Beria: Heber and Melchiel.
17.sabates_a: The sons of Aser: Jamne and Jesua and Jessui and Beria, Sara also their sister. The sons of Beria: Heber and Melchiel,
17.madueke_b: The sons of Aser: Jamne and Jesua and Jessui and Beria, Sara also their sister. The sons of Beria: Heber and Melchiel,

18.s_dismas: Theſe be the ſonnes of Zelpha, whom Laban gaue to Lia his daughter, and theſe ſhe bare to Iacob ſixtene ſoules.
18.odr_com: these be the sonnes of Zelpha, whom Laban gaue to Lia his daughter. and these she bare to Iacob sixtene soules.
18.sabates_a: these be the sons of Zelpha, whom Laban gave to Lia his daughter, and these she bare to Jacob sixteen souls.
18.madueke_b: these be the sons of Zelpha, whom Laban gave to Lia his daughter, and these she bare to Jacob sixteen souls.

19.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Rachel Iacobs wife: Ioſeph and Beniamin.
19.odr_com: The sonnes of Rachel Iacobs wife: Ioseph and Beniamin.
19.sabates_a: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
19.madueke_b: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

20.s_dismas: And theſe were ſonnes borne to Ioſeph, in the Land of Ægypt, which Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis bare to him: Manaſſes and Ephraim.
20.odr_com: And there were sonnes borne to Ioseph, in the Land of Ægypt, which Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar priest of Heliopolis bare to him: Manasses and Ephraim.
20.sabates_a: And there were sons born to Joseph in the Land of Ægypt, which Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare to him: Manasses and Ephraim.
20.madueke_b: And there were sons born to Joseph in the Land of Aegypt, which Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare to him: Manasses and Ephraim.

21.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Beniamin: Bela and Bechor and Aſbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.
21.odr_com: The sonnes of Beniamin; Bela and Bechor and Asbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.
21.sabates_a: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Bechor and Asbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.
21.madueke_b: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Bechor and Asbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.

22.s_dismas: Theſe be the ſonnes of Rachel, which ſhe bare to Iacob: al the ſoules, fourtene.
22.odr_com: these be the sonnes of Rachel, which she bare to Iacob: al the soules, fourtene.
22.sabates_a: These be the sons of Rachel, which she bare to Jacob: all the souls, fourteen.
22.madueke_b: These be the sons of Rachel, which she bare to Jacob: all the souls, fourteen.

24.s_dismas: The ſonnes of Nepthali: Iaziel and Guni and Ieſer and Sallem.
24.odr_com: The sonnes of Nepthali: Iaziel and Guni and Ieser and Sallem.
24.sabates_a: The sons of Nephthali: Jaziel and Guni and Ieser and Sallem.
24.madueke_b: The sons of Nephthali: Jaziel and Guni and Ieser and Sallem.

25.s_dismas: Theſe be the ſonnes of Bala, whom Laban gaue to Rachel his daughter: and theſe ſhe bare to Iacob: al the ſoules, ſeuen.
25.odr_com: These be the sonnes of Bala, whom Laban gaue to Rachel his daughter: and these she bare to Iacob: al the soules, seuen.
25.sabates_a: These be the sons of Bala, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter: and these she bare to Jacob; all the souls, seven.
25.madueke_b: These be the sons of Bala, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter: and these she bare to Jacob; all the souls, seven.

26.s_dismas: Al the ſoules, that entred with Iacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thighe, beſides his ſonnes wiues, ♪ſixtie ſix.
26.odr_com: Al the soules, that entred with Iacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thighe, besides his sonnes wiues, sixtie six.
26.sabates_a: All the souls, that entered with Jacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thigh, besides his son's wives, sixty six.
26.madueke_b: All the souls, that entered with Jacob into Aegypt, and that came out of his thigh, besides his son's wives, sixty six.

27.s_dismas: And the ſonnes of Ioſeph, that were borne to him in the land of Ægypt, two ſoules. Al the ſoules of the houſe of Iacob, that entred into Ægypt, were ſeuentie.
27.odr_com: And the sonnes of Ioseph, that were borne to him in the land of Ægypt, two soules. Al the soules of the house of Iacob, that entred into Ægypt, were seuentie.
27.sabates_a: And the sons of Joseph, that were born to him in the land of Ægypt, two souls, All the souls of the house of Jacob, that entered into Ægypt, were seventy.
27.madueke_b: And the sons of Joseph, that were born to him in the land of Aegypt, two souls, All the souls of the house of Jacob, that entered into Aegypt, were seventy.

28.s_dismas: And he ſent Iudas before him to Ioſeph, that he ſhould tel him, and he ſhould come into Geſſen to meete him.
28.odr_com: And he sent Iudas before him to Ioseph, that he should tel him, and he should come into Gessen to meete him.
28.sabates_a: And he sent Judas before him to Joseph, that he should tell him, and he should come into Gessen to meet him.
28.madueke_b: And he sent Judas before him to Joseph, that he should tell him, and he should come into Gessen to meet him.

29.s_dismas: Whither when he was come, Ioſeph addreſſing his chariot went vp to mete his father, vnto the ſame place: and ſeing him fel vpon his neck, and as they embraced he wept.
29.odr_com: Whither when he was come, Ioseph addressing his chariot went vp to mete his father, vnto the same place: and seing him fel vpon his neck, and as they embraced he wept.
29.sabates_a: Wither when he was come, Joseph addressing his chariot went up to meet his father, unto the same place: and seeing him fell upon his neck, and as they embraced he wept.
29.madueke_b: Wither when he was come, Joseph addressing his chariot went up to meet his father, unto the same place: and seeing him fell upon his neck, and as they embraced he wept.

30.s_dismas: And his father ſaid to Ioſeph: Now wil I die with ioy, becauſe I haue ſeene thy face, and do leaue thee aliue.
30.odr_com: And his father said to Ioseph: Now wil I die with ioy, because I haue seene thy face, and do leaue thee aliue.
30.sabates_a: And his father said to Joseph: Now will I die with joy, because I have seen thy face, and do leave thee alive.
30.madueke_b: And his father said to Joseph: Now will I die with joy, because I have seen thy face, and do leave thee alive.

31.s_dismas: But he ſpake to his brethren, and to al his fathers houſe: I wil goe vp, and wil tel Pharao, and wil ſay to him: My brethren, and my fathers houſe, that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:
31.odr_com: But he spake to his brethren, and to al his fathers house: I wil goe vp, and wil tel Pharao, and wil say to him: My brethren, and my fathers house, that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:
31.sabates_a: But he spake to his brethren, and to all his father's house: I will go up, & will tell Pharao, and will say to him: My brethren, and my father's house that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:
31.madueke_b: But he spake to his brethren, and to all his father's house: I will go up, & will tell Pharao, and will say to him: My brethren, and my father's house that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:

32.s_dismas: and the men are paſtours of ſheepe, and their trade is to feede flockes: their cattel, and heardes, and al that they could haue, they haue brought with them.
32.odr_com: and the men are pastours of sheepe, and their trade is to feede flockes: their cattel, and heardes, and al that they could haue, they haue brought with them.
32.sabates_a: and the men are pastors of sheep, & their trade is to feed flocks: their cattle, & herds, and all that they could have, they have brought with them.
32.madueke_b: and the men are pastors of sheep, & their trade is to feed flocks: their cattle, & herds, and all that they could have, they have brought with them.

33.s_dismas: And when he ſhal cal you, and ſhal ſay: What is your trade?
33.odr_com: And when he shal cal you, and shal say: What is your trade?
33.sabates_a: And when he shall call you & shall say: What is your trade?
33.madueke_b: And when he shall call you & shall say: What is your trade?

34.s_dismas: You ſhal anſwer: We thy ſeruantes are paſtours, from our infancie vntil this preſent, both we and our fathers. And this you ſhal ſay, that you may dwel in the Land of Geſſen, becauſe the Ægyptians a)deteſt al paſtours of ſheepe.
34.odr_com: You shal answer: We thy sernantes are pastours, from our infancie vntil this present, both we and our fathers. And this you shal say, that you may dwel in the Land of Gessen, because he Ægyptians detest al pastours of sheepe.
34.sabates_a: You shall answer: We thy servants are pastors, from our infancy until this present, both we and our fathers. And this you shall say, that you may dwell in the Land of Gessen, because the Ægyptians detest all pastors of sheep.
34.madueke_b: You shall answer: We thy servants are pastors, from our infancy until this present, both we and our fathers. And this you shall say, that you may dwell in the Land of Gessen, because the Aegyptians detest all pastors of sheep.

janvier_by_verse.1: And Israel taking his journey with all things that he had came to the well of the oath, and killing there victims to the God of his father Isaac,
janvier_by_verse.2: he heard him by a vision of the night calling him, and saying unto him: Jacob, Jacob. To whom he answered: Lo here I am.
janvier_by_verse.3: God said to him: I am the most mighty God of thy father: fear not, go down into Ægypt, for into a great nation will I make thee there.
janvier_by_verse.4: I will go down with thee thither, and thence will I bring thee returning: Joseph also shall put his hands upon thine eyes.
janvier_by_verse.5: And Jacob rose up from the well of the oath: and his sons took him up, with their little ones and wives in the wains, which Pharao had sent to carry the old man,
janvier_by_verse.6: and all that he had possessed in the Land of Chanaan: and he came into Ægypt with all his seed,
janvier_by_verse.7: His sons, and nephews, daughters, and all his progeny together.
janvier_by_verse.8: And these are the names of the children of Israel, that entered into Ægypt, himself with his children. His first-begotten Ruben.
janvier_by_verse.9: The sons of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Hesron and Charmi.
janvier_by_verse.10: The sons of Simeon: Iamuel and Jamin and Ahod, and Jachin and Sohar, and Saul the Son of Chananitess.
janvier_by_verse.11: The sons of Levi: Gerson and Caath and Merari.
janvier_by_verse.12: The sons of Juda: Her & Onan and Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were sons born to Phares: Hesron and Hamul.
janvier_by_verse.13: The sons of Issachar: Thola and Phua and Job and Semron.
janvier_by_verse.14: The sons of Zabulon: Sared and Elon and Iahelel.
janvier_by_verse.15: These are the sons of Lia, which she bare in Mesopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. All the souls of his sons and daughters are thirty three.
janvier_by_verse.16: The sons of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni & Esebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.
janvier_by_verse.17: The sons of Aser: Jamne and Jesua and Jessui and Beria, Sara also their sister. The sons of Beria: Heber and Melchiel,
janvier_by_verse.18: these be the sons of Zelpha, whom Laban gave to Lia his daughter, and these she bare to Jacob sixteen souls.
janvier_by_verse.19: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
janvier_by_verse.20: And there were sons born to Joseph in the Land of Ægypt, which Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare to him: Manasses and Ephraim.
janvier_by_verse.21: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Bechor and Asbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.
janvier_by_verse.22: These be the sons of Rachel, which she bare to Jacob: all the souls, fourteen.
janvier_by_verse.24: The sons of Nephthali: Jaziel and Guni and Ieser and Sallem.
janvier_by_verse.25: These be the sons of Bala, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter: and these she bare to Jacob; all the souls, seven.
janvier_by_verse.26: All the souls, that entered with Jacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thigh, besides his son's wives, sixty six.
janvier_by_verse.27: And the sons of Joseph, that were born to him in the land of Ægypt, two souls, All the souls of the house of Jacob, that entered into Ægypt, were seventy.
janvier_by_verse.28: And he sent Judas before him to Joseph, that he should tell him, and he should come into Gessen to meet him.
janvier_by_verse.29: Wither when he was come, Joseph addressing his chariot went up to meet his father, unto the same place: and seeing him fell upon his neck, and as they embraced he wept.
janvier_by_verse.30: And his father said to Joseph: Now will I die with joy, because I have seen thy face, and do leave thee alive.
janvier_by_verse.31: But he spake to his brethren, and to all his father's house: I will go up, & will tell Pharao, and will say to him: My brethren, and my father's house that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:

janvier_by_verse.33: And when he shall call you & shall say: What is your trade?
